onboarding.welcomeBody: A side-by-side workspace for talking with multiple LLMs at once. Group chats, personas, and a sharp keyboard-first surface.
onboarding.addFirstVoiceBody: Connect a provider so sidepad has someone to talk to. You can add more later in Settings.

chatInput.placeholder: Send a message… use @ to address a voice

editFork.headingChoose: How would you like to amend?
editFork.explainer: Revise replaces this entry and discards everything that followed. Branching keeps the conversation whole and starts a new one from this point.

personaForm.promptHint: Sets voice, tone, and constraints for this persona.
personaForm.promptPlaceholder: You are a senior product manager. Always answer…

personasTab.title: Personas
personasTab.body: A persona is a system prompt — a stance, a temperament. Attach one to any voice in a chat to colour its replies. The same model can wear many hats.

skillsTab.title: Skills
skillsTab.body: A skill is a reusable instruction packet — a stance plus optional recommended tools. Enable a skill to compose its addendum into the system prompt.

skillForm.addendumHint: Appended to the persona prompt when this skill is active.
skillForm.toolsHint: Comma-separated tool names matched against connected MCP tools.
skillForm.bodyHint: Markdown body. Stored in the .md file but not injected into prompts.
skillForm.bodyPlaceholder:
# Researcher
Use this skill when factual accuracy matters.

voices.empty: No voices yet. Introduce one to begin.

skills.body: Reusable instruction packets — markdown with frontmatter — that compose into the system prompt.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.body: Light or dark. The interface follows your system by default.
